title: Distance to an inner-product neighbor
statement: Let $m\ge 1$ and write $z=(x,y)$ with $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^m$. Let $p=x_0y_0$. Form $z'$ by replacing $x_0$ with $p+1$ and $y_0$ with $1$, leaving all other coordinates unchanged. Then the Hamming distance from $z$ to $z'$ is at most $2$.
